prayerExcerpt.en-US: Detachment of the mind, at least, is needful to those who cannot venture on an effectual renunciation.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O desapego do espírito, ao menos, é necessário àqueles que não podem aventurar-se a uma renúncia efetiva.

meta.face: A Luxembourg countess of about forty with a fair, clear complexion and a softly TRIANGULAR face — a BROAD, smooth, high forehead and wide-set cheekbones tapering in straight lines to a NARROW, POINTED chin; a SHORT, straight nose; LARGE, prominent, pale-blue eyes set FAR APART under very HIGH, thin, arched fair brows that give a look of calm candour; a small, full, bow-shaped mouth; fair hair in two long plaits falling beside the neck from under the veil; the gaze clear and untroubled, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; the Pericopes of Henry II (German Wikipedia's lead image) show a crowned, veiled empress without individual features. The church model follows the Adamspforte of Bamberg Cathedral and the ploughshare her usual attribute (Wikipedia); the book tells the ordeal of the ploughshares. The triangular face with far-set eyes is our choice, apart from her husband's heart-shaped face on `henry` (batch 13).
